item.title: La Liga: Villarreal Meet Barcelona In Vital Clash As Pressure Stays On Real Madrid Coach Alonso
item.description: Athletic Club Bilbao: The last round of La Liga in 2025 gets underway on Friday and has some vital matches at both the top and the bottom end of the table. The standout game of the weekend sees third-place Villarreal at home to league leaders FC Barcelona on Sunday afternoon, although both sides will go into the clash in very different spirits.

item.title: Venkatesh Iyer To Lead Madhya Pradesh In Vijay Hazare Trophy In Ahmedabad
item.description: Madhya Pradesh Cricket Association: Madhya Pradesh Cricket Association (MPCA) on Thursday selected Venkatesh Iyer as captain of their men's senior team for the Vijay Hazare Trophy league stage, which will be held in Ahmedabad from December 24 to January 8, 2026.

item.title: GCL Season 3: It’s A Very Special Feeling To Get My First Win, Says World Champion Gukesh
item.description: Winning the first game in any event is quite satisfactory, but if it happens after a series of defeats, it is more enjoyable. Dommaraju Gukesh, the reigning World Champion, was obviously elated after winning his first match in Season 3 of the Global Chess League at the Royal Opera House on Thursday.

item.title: India To Name Squads For T20 World Cup 2026 And NZ Series On Saturday
item.description: T20 World Cup: With less than two months remaining before the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, the Ajit Agarkar-led BCCI selection committee is set to meet at its Mumbai headquarters on Saturday to finalise India’s squad for the marquee tournament.

item.title: Athletic Bilbao, Betis Move Into Copa Del Rey Last 16
item.description: Athletic Bilbao: Athletic Bilbao and Betis reached the Copa del Rey last 16 after tough away tests, while Getafe became the latest top-flight casualty in a round of shocks.

item.title: ILT20: Abu Dhabi Knight Riders beat Gulf Giants by four wickets
item.description: Abu Dhabi Knight Riders ride on all-round performance over Gulf Giants to seal second straight win

item.title: Conference League: KuPS Hold Crystal Palace, Fiorentina Edge Through
item.description: UEFA Conference League: KuPS gave Crystal Palace a scare while Fiorentina lost at Lausanne-Sport but both sides progressed on a dramatic final day of league phase action as the line-up for the UEFA Conference League knockout stages was completed.

item.title: NZC Chief Scott Weenink To Step Down From His Role Due To 'differences With Member Associations and NZCPA'
item.description: New Zealand Cricket Players Association: New Zealand Cricket's (NZC) Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Scott Weenink said he will step down from his role on January 30, 2026, after a two-and-a-half-year stint.

item.title: BWF World Tour Finals: Ratchanok Keeps Hopes Alive As Se Young, Akane Reach SF
item.description: Former World Champion Ratchanok Intanon: Former World Champion Ratchanok Intanon of Thailand maintained her chances of advancing from women's singles Group B with a comfortable victory over China's third seed Han Yue in the preliminary league stage of the BWF World Tour Finals on Friday.

item.title: Conway’s Career-Best 227 Guides NZ to Huge Total; WI Openers Steady Reply
item.description: Brandon King and John Campbell comfortably negotiated 23 overs in fading light before stumps to take the West Indies to 110-0 at the end of day two of the third Test after New Zealand declared on a mammoth 575-8 at Mount Maunganui.
